title: Negotiation Strategies for Better Purchasing
overview: Negotiation is a critical skill for any purchasing professional. This course delves into modern negotiation techniques specifically tailored for procurement. It explores the strategies necessary to meet organizational purchasing goals, analyzing both the strengths and weaknesses of buyers and suppliers. Participants will also learn how to adapt negotiation styles to various situations, including more complex negotiations that require strategic approaches.
audience: Ideal for buyers, senior buyers, purchasing supervisors, and all personnel involved in the negotiation process within their organization.
methodology: This course offers a mix of interactive methods such as role-playing, videos, team and individual exercises, case studies, group discussions, and questionnaires to engage participants effectively.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop effective negotiation strategies aligned with purchasing needs
Apply these strategies to maximize value in procurement
Identify the most suitable negotiation style for different situations
Manage complex negotiation scenarios with confidence
Recognize the strengths of both buyers and suppliers
